messages:
Ivy: FYI I opened a focused PR to add a "Short-sequence" section to the Optimize toolkit page (prefetch + quant profiles + migration checklist). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/921
Carlos: Linking — can we be explicit about when to disable KV-prefetch? Ops saw p95 regressions on cold routes. A short rule of thumb would help.
Ivy: Agreed. Drafted a two-line guidance: "Disable KV-prefetch for cold traffic or un-warmed caches; enable only after warmup and when median seq_len >= 64." Added an example toggle.
Mei: Add a small example snippet for toggling per-route in JSON? Helps infra teams. Eg:
```json
{"route": "/short-chat", "kv_prefetch": false}
```
Ivy: Added that exact snippet. Also added a short tradeoff table comparing q8_0 / q4_1 / fp16 for <32 / 32-128 / >128 token ranges.
Ethan: On quant wording: please add a safety fallback sentence: "For safety-critical outputs, prefer fp16 fallback when exact-match regressions exceed 0.5% on validation prompts."
Ivy: Good call, included that and an eval step to run exact-match delta.
Carlos: The Go and JS snippets reference BatchClient names that changed in SDK v0.9.5 -> v0.10.0. Add compatibility notes.
Ivy: Added a compatibility footnote and a tiny migration snippet: 
```python
# if sdk_version < "0.10.0": use legacy Batcher
```
Tara: Ops asked for a conservative canary recipe. Recommend a labeled recipe (low-risk) 5%->20%->50%->100% and a standard 10%->40%->100%. Include monitors: latency_p95, token_cost_delta, exact_match.
Ivy: Done. Included JSON examples for both recipes and linked Console alert templates.
Mei: The examples repo link you used is internal. Please paste a sanitized helper into docs/examples so the public docs don't point to internal repos.
Ivy: Will extract a minimal prefetch helper (50 lines) and add it to docs/examples/prefetch_helper.py. Drafted a one-file snippet in the PR for now.
Carlos: Also add a small script to synthesize a 2k sample prompt set for benchmarking p95/p99 and exact-match. That made our QA much faster.
Ivy: Added synth_promptset.py under examples and a runbook step: "Run sample generator -> measure p95/p99 -> compare exact-match delta".
docs-bot: @Ivy created ticket JIRA-OPT-439 (docs: short-seq playbook + public helper + canary recipes) :bell:
Tara: Quick UX nit  collapse the migration checklist and mark optional/verifiable steps. People like checkboxes.
Ivy: Done 1 added checkboxes and a small verification command example for Console queries: 
```sql
-- pseudo
SELECT sample_id, alignment_pct FROM evals WHERE profile = 'short_seq' ORDER BY alignment_pct ASC LIMIT 50;
```
Ethan: Tiny editorial ask: add a single-line release-note blurb: "Docs: Optimize toolkit 1 short-sequence guidance (prefetch, quant profiles, canary recipes)" so PMs can include it.
Ivy: Added that to the release notes draft. Thanks all :tada:
Mei: I'll do final link/anchor checks and a light copyedit after Ethan signs off on phrasing.
Ethan: I'll review the quant/fallback wording tonight and leave comments by 10:00 PDT.
Ivy: Great  keeping the PR open for review.
